name: gizza-ai/pdf-page-numbers
summary: Add page numbers to a PDF

tool.description: Stamp page numbers onto an existing PDF. Control the label with a `format` template ({n} = page number, {total} = last number printed), the `position` (bottom/top × left/center/right), the numbering `style` (decimal, roman, or letters), the `start_number`, which `pages` to number (1-based; use '2-' to skip a cover page), and the `font`/`font_size`/`color`/`margin`/`opacity`. Provide the PDF as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

color.description: Text colour as a hex code, e.g. #000000 (black), #808080 (grey) or #f00. Default #000000.

font.description: Built-in font family: helvetica (sans), times (serif) or courier (mono). Default helvetica.

format.description: Label template. Use {n} for the page's number and {total} for the last number printed, e.g. '{n}', 'Page {n} of {total}', or '{n} / {total}'. Default '{n}'.

margin.description: Distance from the page edge in points (0–400; 72 pt = 1 inch). Default 36.

opacity.description: Text opacity from 0.05 to 1.0 (1 = fully opaque; lower for a faint watermark-style number). Default 1.

pages.description: Which pages to number, 1-based: 'all' (default), a list/range like '1,3-5', or an open range like '2-' to skip a cover page.

position.description: Where to place the number: bottom or top of the page, left/center/right. Default bottom-center.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

start_number.description: The number printed on the first stamped page; later pages increment from it. Default 1.

style.description: Numbering style: decimal (1,2,3), roman-lower (i,ii,iii), roman-upper (I,II,III), alpha-lower (a,b,c) or alpha-upper (A,B,C). Default decimal.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
